SMTO-WEB-0049 — You declined more research steps for this task

GUID: 2eb83522-eb91-5e59-b45d-f9ef45d9c497
Slug: research-budget-request-already-decided
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • You chose Don't allow when SMTO asked to do more searches, page reads or browser steps of this kind. SMTO respects that and won't ask for the same kind again in this task.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let SMTO finish; its answer will be based on the pages it already read. Your decision stops further lookups of this kind, so the answer uses what SMTO already gathered.
  2. If you change your mind, send a new message telling SMTO it may research the question further. A new message starts a new research request, which SMTO can then ask you to approve.

What success looks like

  • SMTO gives its answer without asking you again for the same kind of extra steps.

If it still fails

  • If SMTO acts as if you had approved, or keeps asking anyway, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • request_research_budget returned denied because an earlier request in this research state was declined and overlaps the newly requested soft-budget keys.

What this means

  • A previous denied budget request overlaps the newly requested soft-budget keys. This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A previous denied budget request overlaps the newly requested soft-budget keys.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the prior denied request and overlapping increment keys.

How to fix it

  • budgets.request() returns status denied when any denied entry in budget_requests shares a soft-budget key with the new increments. Honor the decision: continue within the remaining allowance or finish from existing evidence; do not treat it as approved or resubmit it unchanged.
  • Honor the decision and use remaining allowances or finish with retained evidence.

Retry and execution caution

  • Honor the decision and use remaining allowances or finish with retained evidence.

How to verify the fix

  • Remaining work respects that decision and uses existing allowance or retained evidence.

What not to do

  • Do not treat a declined extension as approved or repeatedly resubmit it unchanged.

Technical notes

  • This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
